title: Velvety Rich Polish Sugars Fondue
description: Rich, gooey, comforting Polish dish featuring al-dente-finish. Perfect for a low-carb-friendly dessert or snack.
instructions: Combine heavy cream, unsalted butter, granulated sugar, light brown sugar, and Polish rye flour in a medium saucepan over medium heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the mixture thickens.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the beaten eggs, vanilla extract, and pinch of salt (if using).
Return the saucepan to medium heat and cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens and coats the back of a spoon.
Transfer the fondue to a fondue pot and serve immediately.
Adjust the seasoning with additional sugar, vanilla extract, or pinch of salt as needed.
Serve the fondue with sliced fruit, cake, or cookies for dipping.
Allow the fondue to cool slightly before serving, if desired.
Use a thermometer to ensure the fondue reaches 160-170°F (71-77°C) for food safety.
